period_note: CRITICAL RESTATEMENT-TIMING EVIDENCE (continued). Half-Yearly filing: 'CONDENSED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited) For the Period (Q-2) From 01 January 2024 to 30 June 2024' -- balance sheet is the 30-June-2024 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/standalone, Shariah-based Islamic bank. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January (H1-cumulative); the filing's own table also prints a discrete 'April'24-June'24' column, captured as the _discrete_quarter fields. Source PDF ('FS_30-06-2024.pdf', filed with a 'Date: 30 July 2024' signature block) is a SCANNED IMAGE document -- independently OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract). Balance-sheet identity reconciles exactly: Total Liabilities (300,346,256,088) + Total Equity (16,750,228,080) = Total Assets (317,096,484,168). P&L chain reconciles exactly: Total Operating Income (4,438,580,610) - Total Operating Expenses (2,085,153,547) = Profit before Provision and Tax (2,353,427,063); - Total Provisions (522,000,000) = Total Profit before Tax (1,831,427,063); - Tax (881,958,726) = Net Profit after Tax (949,468,337). RESTATEMENT-TIMING FINDING: this filing's own 'December 2023' comparative STILL shows the ORIGINAL/contemporaneous FY2023 figures (Total Assets 295,347,564,528; Total Equity 16,337,889,333, exactly matching 2023_Q4.json) -- confirming the manipulation still had not been caught as of 30 July 2024. On the surface this quarter still looks healthy: equity grew further to 16,750.23m and cumulative profit grew to 949.47m (up from 839.47m in H1 2023) -- BUT two early warning signs are visible for the first time when this quarter is compared with Q1: (1) total assets grew an unusually fast 6.9% in a single quarter (296,539.17m to 317,096.48m, versus roughly 2-4% in most other quarters in this series), driven mostly by a jump in 'Investments' (265,705.59m to 274,451.94m) and 'Other Liabilities'/interbank placements funding it; (2) discrete Q2-2024-alone provisioning for classified investments was 260.0m (derived: cumulative 460.0m less Q1's 200.0m), roughly 2.4x the comparable year-ago quarter (Q2 2023 alone: ~100.0m) and already above every single 2022-2023 quarterly figure in this series except the eventual FY2023 year-end. Equity growth of only 41.10m quarter-on-quarter (16,709.13m to 16,750.23m) despite a much larger 570.65m discrete-quarter profit is explained by a 518.14m cash dividend payout during the quarter, not distress. 'Investments Income' (gross) was read from a single, unlabeled OCR column (14,177.10m) with the comparative column illegible -- included with only moderate confidence (the value is internally consistent: it minus Net Investment Income of 3,846.25m implies Profit Paid on Deposits of 10,330.85m, a plausible progression from 9M-2023's 11,688.60m over a shorter, but larger, period). The condensed quarterly filing does NOT disclose classified investments, NPL ratio, or CRAR/capital-adequacy figures. See 2024_Q3.json for where the crack becomes unambiguous.
